items.title: 68113_Barney Bigard oral history interview
items.q: Ben Webster used to come in the band to get stoned and raise holy hell and cuss him out and everything else.

ctx.x: Did very many members of the band --

When I joined the band I didn't drink at all, and what started me drinking was Ben Webster. You see, like Duke sometimes would scold me for something, an insignificant thing. Ben Webster used to come in the band to get stoned and raise holy hell and cuss him out and everything else. Duke don't say nothing -- and get away with it.

So I said, "Why is he giving me hell for nothing? There's a man cussing him out and he doesn't say anything to him." So I said, "I'll try it," and that's when I started drinking. I…
